checklist.title: Set up your grove
checklist.celebrateBody: Your όρια unlock the rest of The Olive Lot. Weather and satellite will appear on the field map.
checklist.continueBody: Draw the όρια to unlock History, photos and the rest of the app.

createGrove.title: Add your first grove
createGrove.body: Give it a name you will recognise. Then find where it is and draw the boundary.

drawBoundary.title: Draw the boundary
drawBoundary.body: Search for the place, then mark the corners for area, slope and satellite.

loadData.title: Load grove data
loadData.body: We are fetching soil, slope and satellite for your boundary.

firstObservation.title: First observation
firstObservation.body: Leave a short note — it starts your History.

createGrove.title: What shall we call it?
createGrove.body: Write the name inside the field. Next we find where it is.

locatePlace.title: Find the place
locatePlace.body: Type a village or area and pick from the list. Then draw the boundary on the map.
locatePlace.cue: Search a village, then pick it.

drawBoundary.title: Draw the boundary
drawBoundary.body: Tap 3–6 points around the grove. When the shape looks right, continue to History.
drawBoundary.cue: Tap the corners on the map.

saveBoundary.title: Save the boundary
saveBoundary.body: The shape looks right. Continue to History to save it.
saveBoundary.cue: Tap Continue to History to save.

firstObservation.title: Record your first note
firstObservation.body: A short observation starts History — you can post the suggested text as-is.

spatial.title: Getting its first page ready
spatial.body: The boundary is in. We are bringing the weather and how the trees look.
spatial.bodyNamed: “{{name}}” is on the map. Weather, trees from above, and the place itself are on the way.
spatial.firstDataHint: When this is ready, you write a short note and History begins.
spatial.stayHere: A moment — nothing to tap yet.

beats.weather0: Rain, heat and wind for this grove…
beats.satellite0: Looking at these trees from above…
beats.personalized1: Reading the slope of this grove…
beats.personalized2: Looking at the soil under these trees…

spatial.successBody: Next you write a short note and History begins.

weather.title: Weather here
weather.body: Rain, heat and wind around the trees.

satellite.title: Trees from above
satellite.body: How green they look, when the sky is clear.

personalized.title: This place
personalized.body: Area, slope and soil of this grove.

welcome.title: “{{grove}}” is ready
welcome.body: Have a look on the map. When you’re ready, we open History.
welcome.pointSatellite: The trees show when the sky is clear
welcome.pointMap: What you write stays in its story

mapExplore.caption: This is your grove on the map. Try a picture below, then open History.

coach.team: From the The Olive Lot team

fieldsNav.title: Welcome
fieldsNav.body: In about a minute your grove is on the map. Tap Fields in the menu and we’ll start.

createField.title: Your first grove
createField.body: Tap the “Add grove” button and write what you call it. You can change it whenever you like.
createField.cue: Tap “+ Add grove” to name your first grove.

homeButton.title: You always know the way back
homeButton.body: The logo at the top left brings you home. That’s how you move around The Olive Lot.

historyNav.title: The story starts with a few words
historyNav.body: Tap History and leave a short note. It becomes the first page of the grove.
historyNav.cue: Tap History — then leave the first note.

firstObservation.title: Write the first note
firstObservation.body: One short note starts History for this grove.
firstObservation.prefill: My first observation in the grove — History begins here.
